title: Kulamalu Park stairs fall lawsuit settlement
summary: A committee backed Resolution 26-147 to settle a lawsuit from a woman who says she fractured her hip on Kulamalu Park stairs that lacked a railing, and the Parks director said no repairs have been made since. The full Council adopted the settlement with eight ayes and one abstention.

timeline.text: Resolution 26-147, authorizing a lawsuit settlement: The Council adopted the resolution to settle a lawsuit against the County.

Motion to recommend adoption of Resolution 26-147, including any non-substantive revisions: The committee voted 7-0 to recommend adoption of Resolution 26-147, which would approve the lawsuit settlement.
